steps.title: Welcome to TurboFoot! ⚽
steps.text: Let's play your first match together. I'll quickly show you how everything works on the field. Let's go!

steps.title: Scoreboard & Timer
steps.text: This is where the match score is displayed. Right below, the counter shows how many plays (actions) remain until the end of the game.

steps.title: The Field Zones
steps.text: The field is divided into 5 zones. The ball ⚽ shows where the action is happening. Advance through the zones until you reach the opponent's goal!

steps.title: Ball Possession
steps.text: This badge shows whether you're ATTACKING (the ball is yours, push forward!) or DEFENDING (the rival is pressuring, hold the line).

steps.title: Choose Your Play
steps.text: Each turn, you choose between 2 or 3 plays. Each one shows its success chance and what happens if it succeeds ❌ or fails ✅.

steps.title: Combo 🔥
steps.text: Successful plays in a row increase your Combo. High Combo unlocks special plays and multiplies your coin reward at the end!

steps.title: Live Commentary
steps.text: The match is narrated in real time here. Follow the action so you don't miss a thing.

steps.title: Ready to play!
steps.text: That's it! Pick the plays with the highest chance of success, build combos, and earn coins. Good luck, manager! 🏆
